question: do most young people watch netflix or streaming often?
answer: Almost half: 49.2% watch streaming platforms fairly or very often (26.3% very often).

question: how many people really dont play videogames
answer: 42.6% never played video games in the last three months.

question: does everyone use whatsapp all day or is that an exageration
answer: It is not an exaggeration: 66.2% use instant messaging apps like WhatsApp very often and another 21.6% fairly often.

question: how did young people watch the world cup games, at home, with friends or at a restaurant
answer: The most common was watching or listening at home (TV or radio, 57.6%), followed by getting together with family or friends (53.1%); only 14.1% went to a restaurant.

question: do they go to the park more or to the bike lane?
answer: Much more to the park: 78.7% went to a park in the last month versus 23.6% to a bike lane.

question: is it easy to get drugs in the city according to young people
answer: Yes: 54.4% say it is very easy and 23.4% say it is somewhat easy.

question: how many young people dont drink any alcohol?
answer: 45.4% say they do not consume alcoholic drinks.

question: who is more disciplined, the one who exercises or the one who eats healthy every day
answer: Eating healthy all week is more common: 29.2% do it all 7 days, versus 9.7% who exercise all 7 days; also 23.5% do not exercise.

question: who do young people live with, still with their parents?
answer: Yes, most live with relatives (84.6%); only 3.4% live alone.

question: do young people sleep well or do they have trouble sleeping
answer: Almost half (46.3%) say they never have trouble sleeping; 14.6% have it many times or always.

question: young people say they would vote but do they actually vote?
answer: There is a gap: 78.4% are willing to vote, but only 30.5% voted in the last 12 months.

question: how many would protest and how many have actualy gone to a march
answer: 30.0% are willing to protest or demonstrate and 12.5% did so in the last 12 months.

question: do men like soccer more than women?
answer: Yes, a lot more: 62.3% of men are soccer fans versus 26.4% of women.

question: are young people bored? do they have free time and not know what to do
answer: Sometimes: 21.7% say they fairly or very often have free time and do not know what to do with it.

question: how many young people barely read books
answer: 28.6% did not read books or magazines in the last three months.

question: do they trust their family more or their neighbours?
answer: Their family: 68.7% have a lot of trust in their relatives versus 15.0% in their neighbors.

question: at what age do young people start living alone?
answer: It rises with age but is still uncommon: 1.9% of those aged 15 to 19 live alone, 2.3% of those aged 20 to 24 and 6.1% of those aged 25 to 29.

question: do the older ones play less videogames?

question: do older young people watch less netflix?

question: do young people feel what they do in life is worth it?
